subject: Operations
title: Carbon Footprint Tracking
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Carbon Footprint Tracking.

hook.text: A company reduced factory emissions 30%. But its supply chain emits 11 times more. The real battle is upstream.

buildup.text: Scope 3 emissions—those from suppliers and logistics—often dwarf a company's direct carbon footprint.

discovery.text: Tracking supply chain carbon requires data from every tier: raw materials, manufacturing, shipping, and last mile.

twist.text: Most companies can't accurately measure Scope 3 because suppliers don't share or track their own emissions data.

climax.text: New regulations in the EU require companies to report full supply chain emissions—transparency is becoming law.

punchline.text: Your biggest carbon problem is in your supply chain.

quiz.question: What are Scope 3 emissions?
options: Emissions from the supply chain and logistics
